question: A sum of x amounts to Rs. 75867 in 2(1)/(2) years at 12% p.a., interest compounded after every 10 months. What is the value of x?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Rate for 10 months = 12% × (10 ÷ 12) = 10%.

Total time = 2.5 years = 30 months = 3 compounding cycles.

Amount = Principal × (1.1)³ = 1.331 × Principal.

Principal = 75867 ÷ 1.331 = 57000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹57000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Amount (A) = ₹75867

Time (T) = 2.5 years = 30 months

Rate (R) = 12% per annum

Interest compounded every 10 months

**Formula Used:**

A = P × (1 + R ÷ 100)ⁿ

**Calculations:**

⇒ Effective rate for 10 months (R) = 12% × (10 ÷ 12) = 10%

⇒ Number of compounding periods (n) = 30 months ÷ 10 months = 3

⇒ 75867 = x × (1 + 10 ÷ 100)³

⇒ 75867 = x × (11 ÷ 10)³

⇒ 75867 = x × (1331 ÷ 1000)

⇒ x = 75867 × 1000 ÷ 1331

⇒ x = 57 × 1000

⇒ x = 57000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹57000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Rate for Compounding

When interest is compounded multiple times, the effective annual rate is higher than the nominal rate. For 3 periods at 10%, the equivalent rate is 33.1%.

Fractional Time Period Method

If time is given in fractions like 2.5 years and rate is annual, convert the total time into months and divide by the compounding frequency to get the number of cycles (n).

Amount vs Principal in CI

Compound interest formula computes the total Amount (Principal + Interest) directly: A = P × (1 + R ÷ 100)ⁿ. To find interest alone, subtract P from A.
